decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet survived the 2024 pruning that removed four of six launches, which suggests it is performing acceptably, and as a low-cost, high-value craftsmanship piece it remains a cheap option worth holding.

The low-pile carpet costs little to keep and passed the 2024 review, but low-pile carpets are rotated frequently and its sibling designs were dropped, so it stays with a somewhat higher risk of withdrawal.
